name: @dina/home-node-lite-web-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end smoke tests for the React Native Web bundle served by brain-server's /web/* route. Opt-in: not part of root 'npm test' because Chromium downloads are heavy. CI invokes it explicitly via 'npm run -w @dina/home-node-lite-web-e2e test:e2e'.
